key.description: The repository's `key`. Records naming it are returned whatever name their URI has, with those naming a repository it was moved from with its owner's agreement.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record; only its owner is matched.

cursor.description: The last URI of the page before.

main.description: Every pull, issue, comment, state change, hide and block anyone has written about a public repository, as an appview has indexed them from the firehose, less what its owner and the appview keep out. A page at a time, ordered by URI: follow `cursor` until it is absent. No authentication; responses are not personalized. Private repositories are never indexed: their readers list the members' records in the space.

value.description: The record verbatim: a dev.knotless.pull, issue, comment, state, hide or block.

author.description: The account the record is in.

description: Every pull, issue, comment and state change anyone has written about a public repository, as an appview has indexed them from the firehose.
